title: An admission retry attempt the drain declines for a cause the retry step does not read is due again every tick with no backoff
outcome: An admission retry attempt the drain declines for a cause the retry step does not read is due again every tick with no backoff
acceptance: A declined admission retry attempt whose cause the step does not read falls back to a bounded re-due instead of repeating every tick, without charging declines whose cause the step does read; a test drives repeated declines and shows the bounded cadence.
